Name: FS Mermaid Pendant for Farmer
Author: beyondrecovery
Description:
[size=3]This Fashion Sense pack adds necklaces meant to resemble the mermaid pendant so that your farmer can wear one too once they're married!

I was inspired by Seasonal Villager Outfits (no longer available) and [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/modpacks/8013-diverse-stardew-valley]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] which include mermaid pendant overlays for the marriageable candidates' portraits. I wanted my farmer to be able to wear one too so I made a tiny necklace for myself several months ago. Some people in the SDV discord expressed that they wanted to do the same so I decided to release the original necklace I made as well as a few variants.

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Version 1 is the original one I made. [/size]
[*][size=3]Version 2 is meant to be true to the actual colors of the pendant chain and top of the shell. Unfortunately I don't feel this one looks as good as the ones with the lighter chains, but wanted to offer it up anyway.[/size]
[*][size=3]Version 3 and 4 are darker shades of blue for the shell, but have the lighter chain of Version 1.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]
[b]INSTALLATION[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Unzip the file and place it in your Mods folder.
[*]In game, pendants will be found in the Accessories section of the Hand Mirror.

[/list][/size][size=3][size=3]
For a platonic option that pairs well with PPaF, check out PurpleChickadee's wearable [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13101]Friendship Bracelet[/url]﻿![/size]
